Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p5); business-type from the proprietary funds total column (p7). ending_cash = governmental funds balance sheet cash and cash equivalents (p4; county treasurer cash 11,279 shown separately); ending_investments = certificates of deposit. General Fund detail from the departmental combining schedule (pp14-15), which ties to the General Fund column of p5; the General Fund budgetary comparison schedule (p10, budgetary basis) is not recorded to avoid double counting. Street and LB840 from their budget schedules (budgetary basis; Street loan proceeds and interest lines had no actual and are omitted). Statement groups the Cemetery department under public works and the Medical Clinic under general government; detail uses health/welfare for both. Proprietary funds have no supplementary schedules, so no business-type detail. Read pages 1-15 of 15
